brief.recommendation: Checkout at 0% success over 30s with $18,400/min revenue at risk (BIZ-4) exceeds the 60s tolerance (BIZ-1). Blocker pid 1492527 is idle in transaction 4.2s with last statement SELECT 1 (DB-1). No protected settlements (DB-2) and no change-calendar window (BIZ-3). However, returns_restock_sync is absent from the workload registry (BIZ-2) so interrupt cost and owner are unknown (BIZ-5). Memory shows terminating similar batch_replayable workers restored checkout (MEM-1), but this is weak evidence for a different workload. Invariants I4 and I9 forbid terminating an unknown workload regardless of business pressure.

audit.report: A returns_restock_sync batch worker (pid 1492527) sat idle in transaction for 4.2 seconds holding locks that blocked all checkout sessions, driving success from 55% to 0% over 30 seconds with $18,400/min revenue at risk. The Database Guardian proposed terminating the blocker, citing no protected settlements and no active change window. The Continuity Guardian rejected because returns_restock_sync is absent from the workload registry, making interrupt cost unknown; invariants I4 and I9 prohibit terminating unregistered workloads. Negotiation timed out after 417.7 seconds (far past the 60-second business tolerance) and escalated to on-call with no automated action taken.
audit.root_cause: An unregistered returns_restock_sync batch worker held locks idle-in-transaction, blocking checkout, and guardians could not agree on termination due to registry invariants.
lessons: Register returns_restock_sync in the workload registry with owner, replayability, and interrupt-cost metadata so future negotiations can evaluate termination under I4/I9.
audit.negotiation_critique: Database Guardian correctly identified the blocker and deterioration but could not overcome invariants I4/I9; Continuity Guardian properly enforced registry policy but had no fallback when the workload was missing. Neither guardian wasted rounds — the single round ended in policy deadlock.
follow_ups: Add returns_restock_sync to workload_registry with replayable=true and interrupt_cost=low before next deploy.
Implement the idle-in-transaction >2s alert for batch workers blocking checkout.
Review invariants I4/I9 for an emergency override when checkout success hits 0% and blocker shows no active work.
